original_card.question: Can the native P104 low-rank channel be completed with a legal, fully charged I-G/2 side correction?
methods: Construct one side-correction word at an explicit chronological cut with the needed frames still available.
Derive a lower bound on the side correction and hosting costs that decides whether this channel can beat the selected budget.
original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier.

first_step.inspect: Read the P104 open next questions and its fixed local histogram; inspect why appending I-G/2 after source completion is not justified. #1991 supplies the checked native channel, not the missing correction.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only. Read the named package and review before relying on its local evidence; this command is not its replay or supplier admission.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one exact side-correction cut and bound its allowed cost from a favorable completed moment at a declared target. Stop or hand off if the necessary source/target access cannot be justified or even the optimistic total misses the target.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Completing an already realized changed channel tests a concrete construction opportunity, instead of refining the incumbent packing. A positive local result still needs global and all-size admission.
allowed_variations: One correction factorization, one chronological cut, or one explicit hosting obstruction.
A changed correction schedule with an updated full bill and native frame contract.
scope_change_triggers: Recompiling the already certified low-rank channel without closing a new obligation.
Treating a pending ancestor, local histogram or unpriced side correction as an admitted global supplier.

actual_scope: Exact minimum 78 new monotone X-only source-acquisition lifetimes for P104 Y0/Y1, with a matching dirty-restored common-chart word and full local bill.
scope_change_reason: Take PR2393 explicit two-target feeder-sharing handoff; this proves one missing local construction/interface rather than claiming complete P104 supplier admission.
bottleneck_link: Tests actual reusable source acquisition instead of summing one-target lifetime lower bounds; full global/physical admission remains separate.
stop_rule: Stop after exact two-target proof, fixed word, independent replay and preservation; no all-target search or new round.
evidence: CIRCUIT.json, SEPARATE.json, RESULT.json, REVIEW.md and two exact replays; no_new_kappa.
author: Ross Richardson
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in all derivation, code, verification and writing, including a separate exact-circuit specialist. No independent human or formal-kernel review.
